messages.subject: Timeseries CSV for one night sleep anylasis
parts:
Hi all, 

I am working with the Gentactive data (Newcastle polysomnography and accelerometer data by VanHess). I am wondering if I can get a time-series CSV from GGIR to better understand and compare with ground truth. it seems GGIR can only provide time-series csv for 24-hour recording instead of one-night recording for sleep analysis.  
since part5 save_ms5rawlevels which belongs to behavioural classes and non-wear with 24 hours data, but i did not get for one night reording. 
any clarification would be appreciated. 

Kind Regards, 
Abdul Haleem

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: Timeseries CSV for one night sleep anylasis
parts:
Hi Abdul,

Please try to clarify if you already solved your previous issue before posting new questions: https://groups.google.com/g/RpackageGGIR/c/6S7eCE3mcaw

As for this question, what information do you need in the time series? If it is only acceleration metrics then you can use the time series exported in part 2 with "epochvalues2csv = TRUE". If you need behavioural classification, then you can get the part 5 time series, please note that those are exported with invalid data excluded by default, set "save_ms5raw_without_invalid = FALSE". 

Note that if your file does not meet the minimum recording length to be processed by part 5, then part 5 time series would not be available.

Best,
Jairo
